name: What is commercial remodeling?

acceptedAnswer.text: Commercial remodeling involves updating or renovating a business property to improve its functionality, aesthetics, or meet new operational needs. This can range from minor cosmetic changes to major structural alterations, including interior redesigns, exterior improvements, or reconfiguring office layouts. The goal is often to enhance customer experience, boost employee productivity, or comply with updated building codes and accessibility standards. It differs from residential remodeling primarily in scale, regulatory requirements, and specialized material considerations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Commercial remodeling updates or renovates a business property to improve functionality, aesthetics, or operational needs, differing from residential projects in scale and regulations.
